content.comment_body: Hello, I'm an end user experiencing difficulty connecting to my [product_name] modules. I couldn't find another source for help, so I'm posting here. I have two [article_no] [product_name] modules with input/output expansion modules attached. 1. I recently purchased a new Windows 10 PC, but when I install the [product_name] software from the CD, it only installs a demo version. I can't find instructions on how to activate the full version, and the demo doesn't permit upload or download of files. The cable box includes a code, but I'm unsure if it's for the software or just for the cable. 2. I tried downloading the v8 demo plus the USB driver, but as expected, the demo won't let me transfer my .lsc files. Is it possible to test if my setup works, or does it only work after activating the software? 3. Will this configuration function properly with Windows 10? Thanks for any assistance.

The demo version cannot be activated, and there is no license key like with [product_name]. You need to purchase the full version. Only the full version allows for a connection between your PC and the [product_name] module. If you buy the current release ([product_name] V[version_no]), it is compatible with Windows 10. The order number is [article_no]. Additionally, be sure to run the installer as administrator.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing challenges enabling full functionality in the [product_name] software on Windows 10. The demo version limits essential features such as file upload and download, leading to confusion regarding activation procedures and product codes. Uncertainty exists about licensing, activation, and compatibility with Windows 10.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate activating the complete [product_name] software by using a supplied activation code or the information in the cable box, testing their setup with [product_name] modules, and confirming Windows 10 compatibility.
